title: Replication Failure and Trivial Baselines in Road-Level Crash Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.35917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph neural networks are increasingly applied to road-level crash prediction, but the stability of their reported gains has received little scrutiny. We independently reconstruct the data pipeline of a recent uncertainty-aware model and evaluate eleven of its design decisions across three London boroughs under an expanding-window protocol. Four survive replication on a second borough; seven do not, and four of those reverse sign rather than attenuate. Multi-seed evaluation is decisive: one effect reverses sign between random seeds within a single borough, and the reference architecture exhibits per-borough seed spreads of up to 35.7 points against 4 points for ours. We further compare both networks against a parameter-free baseline that ranks segments by cumulative past crash count. translated_title: 道路级碰撞预测中的复现失败与平凡基线
translated_abstract: 图神经网络正日益被应用于道路级碰撞预测，但其报告的性能提升的稳定性却很少受到审视。我们独立重建了一个近期的不确定性感知模型的数据流水线，并在三个伦敦行政区上，采用扩展窗口协议评估了该模型的十一个设计决策。其中四个设计决策在第二个行政区的复现中得以保留；七个未能保留，而这七个中有四个不仅没有减弱，反而出现了符号反转。多种子评估具有决定性意义：某一效应在同一行政区内的不同随机种子之间出现符号反转，且参考架构在每个行政区的种子间性能波动高达35.7分，而我们的模型仅为4分。我们进一步将这两个网络与一个无参数基线进行比较，该基线仅按累积历史碰撞次数对路段进行排序。在匹配的历史深度下，我们的模型与该基线在统计上不可区分（-0.90分，p=0.61），而参考架构则输给了……
tldr: 本研究通过独立复现与多种子评估发现，图神经网络在道路级碰撞预测中的多数设计决策无法跨区域稳定复现，且其性能并不优于按历史碰撞次数排序的简单无参数基线。
en_tdlr: This study independently replicates a graph neural network model for road-level crash prediction, showing that most of its design decisions fail to generalize across boroughs and that both networks are matched or outperformed by a trivial parameter-free baseline ranking segments by cumulative past crash counts.
